title: ken-4: tests for keystore module + hotplug integration
description:
Test coverage for the USB flash backend.

New files:
- test/wp11_test_keystore.c: create .p11k + load round-trip; wrong PIN returns error; wrong magic returns WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_UNSUPPORTED; truncated file returns error; PBKDF2 iterations < 100000 rejected; correct entry count and labels after load; mlock/munlock lifecycle
- test/vectors/p11k_framing.json: hand-constructed test vectors using external oracle (Python cryptography library or openssl), NOT generated from code under test
- test/wp11_test_pkcs11.c: add test for flash slot appearing when keystore file created via wp11_test_inject_flash_path() hook

All vectors must have an independent source (known PBKDF2 output, known AES-GCM ciphertext).
